date.basis: the header count only; the entry does not date the cisterns

notes: Entry grid 1829/1883 is the unit point exactly. Three cisterns are given only in the header field, with no position. The moat (4-5 m wide, 2 m deep) that separates the medieval fortress from the ridge is a ditch, so it is not coded as a pool or pit. The water source is 'Ain el-Far'ah, 0.5 km away, a spring. The entry has no site plan; Figs. 334-335 are a photo and pottery.
